label: 1 - Acquisition
info: Modbus TCP / SunSpec poll of the inverter, INCLUDING the observed effective §14a power limit. Placeholder - real Modbus wiring is future work.

name: Acquisition (Modbus TCP/SunSpec poll incl. effective grid limit)
info: Reads inverter registers on an interval and normalizes them into the telemetry payload (docs/contracts/mqtt-telemetry.schema.json).

label: 2 - Publish
info: mTLS MQTT publish (QoS1) to ems/{tenant}/{site}/{device}/telemetry and .../status. Only outbound connections.

name: Publish (mTLS MQTT QoS1 -> EMQX)
info: Publishes telemetry/status to EMQX. No inbound ports on the edge.

label: 3 - Schedule-Exec
info: Executes the retained cloud schedule slot-by-slot (15-min slots) from ems/{tenant}/{site}/{device}/schedule.

name: Schedule-Exec (retained schedule, 15-min slots)
info: Applies the current slot setpoint to the inverter via the Guards flow.

label: 4 - Default-Watchdog
info: Falls back to a self-consumption default if the cloud connection / schedule is lost (edge autonomy).

name: Default-Watchdog (self-consumption default on outage)
info: Monitors schedule freshness and switches to the self-consumption default when stale.

label: 5 - Guards
info: Local plausibility checks before any write to the inverter (safety envelope, incl. observed §14a limit).

name: Guards (local plausibility checks before write)
info: Clamps/blocks setpoints that violate local limits before actuation.
